validationContract.alphaGridPurpose: Prospectively locked software-validation grid inside the article range; not asserted to be the authors' undisclosed averaging grid.

temperatureInput.reason: The redundant author Kelvin column equals T_C+273.00 and is scientifically inconsistent by 0.15 K.

validationContract.branchRule: Exactly one upward crossing and zero downward crossings at every locked target alpha; no smoothing, sorting, extrapolation, or source-file repair.

knownHumanProducedSourceIssues.decision: Do not use the redundant Kelvin column for the hard oracle; convert the Celsius column with +273.15.
The column labelled 1/T stores approximately 1000/T_author_K; ignore it and calculate reciprocal temperature from corrected kelvin.
Use the fail-closed unique-upward-crossing projection. Every locked 0.05-spaced target has one upward and no downward crossing.
Retain physical source-row numbering and ignore rows whose mapped fields are all blank.
Retain the immutable source byte-for-byte; exclude the post-data one-cell row with an explicit WIDE_TRAILING_INCOMPLETE_ROW_EXCLUDED warning.
Article states 20 mL/min while dataset metadata states 40; do not encode a flow value in the kinetic oracle until resolved.

publicationAdjudication.fwo: soft comparison only; author-K path reproduces 176.9 kJ/mol at the locked grid
publicationAdjudication.kas: quarantined as hard oracle; reported 167.3 is consistent to the reported tenth with wrongly applying FWO's 1.052 coefficient to equation-correct author-K KAS
publicationAdjudication.friedman: quarantined as hard oracle; a related 1.052 signal exists but derivative/smoothing details and Figure 6 prevent a definitive author-error claim
publicationAdjudication.spreadValues: quarantined; the article does not define the ± statistic or exact alpha grid
publicationAdjudication.internalPublicationConflict: Torr3 Friedman spread is ±84 in Table 3 and ±87 in prose

promotionRule: Promote from gold-candidate to gold only after the Decimal oracle, raw production path, manual alpha=0.50 adjudication, full regression suite, native macOS run, and hosted Linux/Windows runs all pass.
rebaselinePolicy: Any source, oracle, manual, tolerance, grid, or expected-output hash change requires a written scientific reason and a fresh three-way application/oracle/manual adjudication.
